coordinate_system: Source and destination use continuous square-pixel edge coordinates: top-left edge is (0,0), pixel (x,y) has center (x+1/2,y+1/2), +x is right and +y is down.
transform_order: Crop is selected in normalized full-source space first. Let a=(anchor.x*sourceWidth,anchor.y*sourceHeight). Forward geometry is p'=position+a+R_clockwise(rotation)*diag(scale.x,scale.y)*(p-a). Rasterization inverse-maps every destination pixel center through that expression; anchor remains relative to the full source.
degenerate_scale: If either scale component is exactly zero, the affine image has zero area and the complete output is transparent. Negative scale components mirror through the anchor.
crop_semantics: The crop rectangle is half-open in continuous source edge coordinates. Bilinear taps whose pixel centers fall outside the crop are transparent rather than clamped; an inverse-mapped filter footprint may still overlap an in-crop tap when its center is on or beyond an edge, producing a deterministic premultiplied-alpha crop boundary.
sampling_semantics: Inverse-map each destination pixel center, subtract (1/2,1/2) to address the source pixel-center lattice, and combine the four floor/ceil taps with exact rational separable bilinear weights in linear-light premultiplied RGBA. Identity mapping reproduces source pixels exactly.
edge_semantics: A tap outside the full source or outside the half-open crop contributes transparent black. There is no edge extension, repeat, mirror, host filter or hidden resize policy.
quantization: Form each complete exact weighted channel sum, then round once to nearest uint16; an exact half chooses the even integer. No intermediate pixel rounding, float, SIMD approximation, dithering or clamp is permitted.
trig_semantics: Reduce exact rational degrees to [-180,180), reflect to [-90,90], multiply by the frozen 101-significant-digit decimal pi rational, evaluate sine and cosine with exactly 40 alternating Taylor terms, apply quadrant signs, then round each once to a signed int64 coefficient divided by 2^48 using nearest-even. Those Q48 rationals are normative; inverse mapping divides by their exact determinant cos²+sin² rather than assuming rounded coefficients remain perfectly orthonormal.
cancellation_semantics: Check context before validation and allocation, at least every 64 destination pixels, before and after immutable Surface construction, and before return. Failure never returns a partial Surface.
allocation_semantics: Validate input/output dimensions, output pixel count, exact-value bit bounds and two complete output-frame bytes before allocation. The source Surface is caller-owned and excluded from MaxWorkingBytes. A fixed-count common-denominator big.Int sampler scratch is also excluded; its coefficient size is bounded by MaxExactBits and the frozen Q48/Taylor profile, while it is reused across all pixels rather than retained per pixel.
excluded_responsibilities: Media decode, color normalization, source frame selection, opacity, layer compositing, masks, perspective, non-square pixels, motion blur, text/vector rasterization, output conversion, encoding and muxing are outside this profile.
